title: Binary convolution coefficient
statement: For a natural number $\ell$, let $a,b\in(\mathbb{Z}/2\mathbb{Z})^\ell$ and let $d\in\mathbb{N}$. The binary convolution coefficient of degree $d$ is the sum in $\mathbb{Z}/2\mathbb{Z}$ of $a_i b_j$ over pairs of natural numbers with $i+j=d$ and $i,j<\ell$.
